item.text:
- “the stakes for our company has never been higher” >>> “the stakes for our company have never been higher”
- “federal goverment” >>> “federal government”
- “more then ever” >>> “more than ever”
- “three cosponsors on the committee, Senators Okafor and Lindqvist” >>> “[CHECK: the memo says there are three cosponsors but names only two]”
- “it's definitions” >>> “its definitions”
- “central principal” >>> “central principle”
- “enforcment regime” >>> “enforcement regime”
- “directly effect every company” >>> “directly affect every company”
- “Senator Whitfield (R-OK)” >>> “[CHECK: the memo identifies Whitfield as R-OH above]”
- “narrows the registry in Section 5” >>> “[CHECK: the bill describes the registry in Section 4]”
- “keeps the $10 million daily civil penalty” >>> “[CHECK: the bill summary gives a $1 million-per-day civil penalty]”
- “the amendment's changes is modest” >>> “the amendment's changes are modest”
- “Gallager” >>> “Gallagher”
- “of the committees 28 members, 13 are yes or leaning yes, 10 are no or leaning no, and 6 are undecided” >>> “[CHECK: these categories total 29, not 28]”
- “The undecided senators are Chen, Ellis, Alvarez, Pike, and Barlow” >>> “[CHECK: this lists five senators, while the memo says six are undecided]”
- “before the markup on Thursday, October 14” >>> “before the markup on Thursday, October 15”
- “in a seperate interview” >>> “in a separate interview”
- “The list of undecided senators, along with their staff contacts, are attached” >>> “The list of undecided senators, along with their staff contacts, is attached”
- “Commerce Commitee markup” >>> “Commerce Committee markup”
- “as soon as the week November 16” >>> “as soon as the week of November 16”
- “hearing ... occured” >>> “hearing ... occurred”
- “within two years” >>> “[CHECK: Section 6 says the international agreement is to be negotiated within 18 months]”
- “a close compliment” >>> “a close complement”
- “the the offices” >>> “the offices”
- “call there senators” >>> “call their senators”
- “you should recieve” >>> “you should receive”
- “Our six regional policy leads” >>> “[CHECK: the memo later says there are five regional policy leads]”
